skill.displayName: 自动为文章添加参考文献
skill.summary: 自动为学术文章添加参考文献。解析文章内容提取主题和关键词， 调用 academic-search 检索相关论文，推荐候选文献供用户确认， 自动插入格式化的引用。支持 Markdown/LaTeX/Word 输入， 输出 BibTeX/GB/T 7714/APA 格式。当用户说"帮我加参考文献"、 "给这篇文章找引...

latestVersion.changelog:
auto-citation v1.0.0

- Initial release for automatic academic citation assistance.
- Detects user intent or file type to trigger citation workflow.
- Parses document to extract topics, keywords, and existing references.
- Utilizes academic-search to recommend relevant papers for user confirmation.
- Supports citation insertion for Markdown, LaTeX, and Word files.
- Outputs formatted citations in BibTeX, GB/T 7714, or APA styles.
